meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 按技能流程为 HyperFrames 合成编写可跳转(seek-safe)的 2D/3D 关键帧:先明确动画主体、可见状态与时长,再选最小实现机制,同步创建并注册 GSAP 等时间线,最后用 CLI 诊断和截图验证;不使用随机时间、定时器或无限循环等不可靠写法。
howto.when: 当用户提到 GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、SVG 变形/描边等 seek-safe 关键帧需求,或要求运行 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断时触发;不用于整体场景策略、品牌设计等。

say.text: 给这个 HyperFrames 场景里的方块加一段可跳转的 GSAP 位移动画。
把这条 SVG 路径改成从起点逐渐描边画出的关键帧。
运行 hyperframes keyframes 诊断,告诉我哪些属性有中间帧。

howto.what_en: Writes seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes for HyperFrames: identifies subject/states/runtime, picks smallest mechanism, builds and registers synchronous paused GSAP-style timelines, verifies via CLI diagnostics/snapshots; avoids timers, unseeded random, infinite loops.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user requests seek-safe keyframes for HyperFrames—e.g., GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, SVG morph/draw, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics—not for broad scene strategy, brand design, or general video planning.

say_en.text: Add a seek-safe GSAP position tween for this block in the HyperFrames scene.
say_en.note: Creates a paused timeline registered to the compositionId.

say_en.text: Turn this SVG path into keyframes that draw the stroke from the start.
Run `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics and tell me which properties have middle keyframes.
say_en.note: Runs lint/check/keyframes and explains the diagnostic output.
